notes.title: New Hide & Seek game mode & Added Combat system!
notes.content:
Version 1.5.9.2 is Here!

New Game Mode: Hide & Seek is here!
Some players become Seekers with powerful swords. They must kill a Hider to avoid elimination.

Hiders must survive till the timer ends — if killed, the Seeker becomes a Hider!

⚠️ Seekers can’t kill each other.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048489/f561fda2adeb377f8c27b15ff8e323be39f51a30.png"]
Introducing Combat Update!
Added kill detection!

Improved death logs! Now it will show which player killed which one!

Added Health Bars! Now you can see health of every players!

If player goes background, it will still have damage and will get killed if someone is hitting player! Previously it didn't worked.


How the kill gets detected? 
When you hit player with weapon that does damage. And if the player gets killed with that weapon, the kill gets recorded! 

Another Case: What if you hit player with damage and that player fall to their death or drowned in water because of your push? Will that count as kill? 

In this case, if player dies in other circumstances like fall damage or drowning after your hit. If this happens within 10 seconds, that kill will be credited to the player and will not record as fall death or drowning. 

Whoever damages player at last gets that kill! If above conditions are met!


Others:
Fixed fly bug in football!

Added new Dark Outfit Pattern!

notes.title: Introducing Solo Matches & Major Multiplayer Changes
notes.content:
Introducing Solo Matches

 The game will now allow you to have a solo match while you wait for other players to join!
 Solo matches will only have 1 round per session.
 You will even earn Rumbles if you win a solo match.
 Solo match will include games modes which are playable as single player.
 Solo matches will choose the game mode which you have selected. And if you have not selected any game which is supported by a single player then the solo match will override your choice and will include games on its own.
 Solo match will not start if someone joins a lobby while countdown.


You can now join Started Lobbies!

 Now you will be able to join mid / started games!
 If the game is started, you will join as spectator until the session ends.


Multiplayer Improvements

 Improved Bomb Tag game mode! (Internal changes)
 Reduced huge loads on the Host, while maintaining, processing and updating all joined player data. This will improve game stability as the host will now not have much load especially with a high amount of players.
 The game will no longer Wait for players who are already eliminated and are just spectators when a new game is about to start. This will reduce the chances of the game getting stuck at Waiting For Players.


Changes & Fixes

 Increased radius of Bomb Sounds (Burning, Explosion).
 Reduced Football game duration to 2 Minutes when only 2 players are playing it.
 Fixed a bug in Mingle which sometimes doesn't kill players which are not inside rooms.

notes.title: Version 1.3.1 is here! Added new Lobby Map & More!
notes.content:
Version 1.3.1 is here!

What's new:

 Added new Lobby Map: Large Pool!

 Added Symbol which will appear when Host has modifed Game Mode or Map.

 Team games will no longer be selected if the required number of teams would result in an uneven player distribution, as this could create an unfair gameplay experience.

 If a team game has been specifically selected from the game selection, the system will attempt to prioritize other game modes when available.

 However, if the last played game mode is one of the alternatives and the only remaining option is a team game, the system will override its rule to prevent repeating the last played mode. In such cases, the team game will not be selected due to the uneven player distribution, and players will need to replay the previous game mode instead.

notes.title: Version 1.3 is Here! 2 New Game Modes and Maps and More!
notes.content:
New in Version 1.3
Features:

 Added 2 NEW Game Modes: Football and a popular game Red Light Green Light!
 Added 2 NEW Maps: Skyfield Stadium and Rush Yard!
 Added a feature which will let the lobby host to Disable Game modes and Maps in the lobby! It can be changed anytime.
 Added Ban / Unban feature. You can now ban players from the lobby! After banning the player you can also unban the players easily from the UI.
 Added support for Discord Rich Presence!
 Added support for Guest Sign In, you can use it if you are unable to sign in with Steam account. You can always convert the guest account to Steam account from Main Menu.


Fixes:

 Increase the height of the lobby name text, so that the entire text will not get hidden when the character size is greater than the text height.
 Fixed the version color bug in Lobby list UIs, which shows the red color of version text sometimes even if the user and host are on same version.


Changes:

 Bomb Tag and Stick Tag will no longer continue to run when the player alive is 1 and the player who left didn't had bomb and stick before leaving.
 Slightly increased the walk, sprint speed of player while playing Football. This also applies in crouch walk and sprint.


Improvements:

 Optimized Chat system!
 Other Various Improvements!

notes.title: Added new Features plus Major Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Features

 Added Death Indicator in lobby details panel! A small gravstone will appear indicating player has died in that session.
 Added support for Chinese, Korean, Japanese and Thai languages. It is now writable and visible in chats.
 The lobby detail panel now shows both current players and max players for which the lobby was created.


Changes

 The lobbies which are full will now appear at bottom of lobbies which have empty slots available. (In Lobbies UI Panel).
 If lobby is created for less than 30 players, the timer will get adapt to the selected max players and will be run for less than 20 seconds.
 Patched the Rich Tag texts, user can no longer mess with texts in Lobby names and chat by using rich tags.


Fixes

 Fixed the glitches which occur when player dies.
 Fixed a bug which caused Lobby Details UI to be empty when player joined the game when the game is in Finding Random Map screen.
 Fixed a bug which caused session summary to not get active when there is change in Host lobby and player selected lobby.
 The player will no longer gets stuck on Beach table in Poolside Paradise and also any objects in the game. The game will just push the player when the player is standing on very edge of an object.

notes.title: Major Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Improvements

 Improved Random Map and Game Selection Mechanism. The game will now try to find maps which are more fun to players! And more!
 Improved User experience while attempting to join lobbies.


Fixes

 Fixed various major issues regarding gameplay.
 Fixed the clock ticking sound was not playing since few versions of the game.
 Fixed the grammar of Jump Rush game mode description (Based on the player's feedback).
 Fixed a major issue which made the player sometimes stuck on the edge of any objects.


Changes

 Reduced timer of Tile Puzzle game mode to 1:30 Minutes from 2:00 minutes
 Reduced timer of Race (Marathon) map to 2:30 minutes from 3:00 Minutes.
 Grass will now have shadows when the graphics quality is set to High Fidelity!
 The Sword will now Despawn when the player holding it dies.
 The items which player holds like bomb, sword, stick will no longer have jittery movement.
 The player can now fall inside the middle small hole in Palm Oasis Island and can get eliminated!
